_about: Channels that are NOT in the 018CG's VS20 pseudo-address table and so cannot be
generated from it. They were located by reading the load-path code in Ghidra, and
the McMESS responder will serve any RAM address, so the table is a naming
convenience rather than a limit on what can be read.
tools/build_database.py merges this file into the generated database. Edit it here,
not in m38_018cg.json, which is regenerated.
Everything below is tagged [RE] or [INF] in 'source'. [RE] means the address was read
out of the instruction stream; [INF] means the scaling was argued from the code's
fixed-point arithmetic rather than taken from a DAMOS entry. None of it has been
